title: Scouts UK
description: Scouts UK is a youth organization whose brand palette includes bright purple (#7413dc), cyan (#088486), blue (#003982), light pink (#ffb4e5), amber (#ffe627), teal (#205b41), bright red (#ed3f23), bright blue (#006ddf), orange (#ff912a), green (#25b755), black (#000000), and white (#ffffff). Colors are documented in Scouts UK brand guidelines.
